annotations.title: Counterparty Address Poisoning & Vanity Prefix/Suffix Spoof Detector

description: Compares a target recipient wallet address against recent transaction history to detect vanity prefix/suffix lookalike spoofing and zero-value dusting attacks. Use when verifying a recipient EVM or Solana wallet address before sending funds; for decoding hex smart contract calldata payloads, use simulate_evm_transaction_calldata instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'target_address' ('address_standard' defaults to 'auto_detect'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (100 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

address_standard.description: Address encoding format; defaults to 'auto_detect' when omitted.

target_address.description: Candidate recipient EVM (0x...) or Solana Base58 wallet address to verify.

name: detect_address_poisoning_scam

poisoning_detected.description: True if a prefix/suffix collision with a different middle body is found.

prefix_suffix_collision_score.description: Similarity score (0.0 to 1.0) against known counterparty addresses.
